```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```

```{python}
# Learn morea about Code Cells: https://quarto.org/docs/reference/cells/cells-jupyter.html

# Include and execute your code here
df = pl.read_csv("https://posit.byui.edu/content/0d43d66f-d3b7-4c43-8c36-52e3ed69e7f1/names_year_csv.csv")
```

```{python}
# Q1
elliot = df.filter(pl.col("name") == "Elliot").select("name", "year", "Total")

labels = pl.DataFrame({
    "year":  [1982 - 0.5, 1984 + 0.5, 2002 + 0.5],   # small offset so text doesn't touch the line
    "label": ["E.T. Released", "Second Release", "Third Release"],
    "hjust": [1, 0, 0]                               # 1 = left of line, 0 = right of line
})


(ggplot(elliot, aes(x="year", y="Total", color="name"))
+ geom_line(size=1)
+ scale_color_manual(values=["blue"])
+ geom_vline(color="red", xintercept=1982,linetype="dashed", size=1) 
+ geom_vline(color="red", xintercept=1984,linetype="dashed", size=1)
+ geom_vline(color="red", xintercept=2002, linetype="dashed", size=1)
+ labs(title="Elliot...What?", x="year", y="")
+ scale_x_continuous(format="d", expand=(0,0), breaks=np.arange(1950, 2031, 10))
+ scale_y_continuous(breaks=np.arange(0, 30001, 500), limits=[-100, 3200], expand=[0, 0])
+ xlim(1950)
+ theme_gray()
+ theme(axis_ticks=element_blank(), panel_grid_minor=element_blank(), legend_justification=[0,1], plot_title_position="plot", axis_text=element_text(family="Merriweather"), plot_title=element_text(family="Merriweather", hjust=0), legend_title=element_text(family="Merriweather"),
legend_text=element_text(family="Merriweather"),
axis_title=element_text(family="Merriweather"))
+ geom_text(aes(x="year", label="label", hjust="hjust"), data=labels, y=3000, size=7, color="#444444", inherit_aes=False, show_legend=False)
)

```
